english.title: Fail to comply with requirements regarding the making / retention / furnishing of documents
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person subject to a duty of care in respect of controlled waste under section 34(1) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 as **(..SPECIFY BASIS OF DUTY..), failed to comply with a requirement imposed by regulation 35 of the Waste (England and Wales) Regulations 2011, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 35 of the Waste (England and Wales) Regulations 2011 and section 34(5) and (6) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.

english.notes: This offence wording document provides for the offence under section 34(5); prior to 7th January 2019, this offence was included under EP90024, which has been split to provide a separate offence wording for each subsection covered by that document. See also EP90023 in relation to subsection (1), EP90136 in relation to subsection (1A), and EP90137 in relation to subsection (2A).

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

In relation to a person who fails to comply with the requirements imposed by section 34(5), an Enforcement Authority may issue a fixed penalty notice, as per section 34A.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
